why: Removes the bounds check, so `deps.levels.levels[7]` on a five-level sequence is `undefined` and the world build reads properties off it. Since #428 this throws out of a HUD click handler -- into `boot.ts`'s start guard, which paints the no-WebGL message for a defect that has nothing to do with WebGL. `if (true)` rather than a deletion so the branch body still runs and the entry measures the CHECK rather than the assignment. 2 of 412: the out-of-range case and the non-integer one, which is the pair that separates the range test from the integer test -- a check that kept only `picked < length` would still pass the first.
